app.name: Spokebook
account.password.hint: Changing the password signs you out on all other devices.
account.backup.hint: Export all your data (bikes, odometer readings, components, component types, catalog steps, maintenances, rides and photos and documents) as a ZIP file or restore it from such a file. Older backups as a JSON file can still be imported. Your account and passkeys are not part of the backup.
account.passkey.delete.confirm: Delete the passkey “%s”? You can then no longer sign in with it.
account.passkey.field.name: Name
account.passkey.name_hint: Where the passkey is stored, e.g. “iPhone” or “YubiKey”.
account.passkey.unsupported: This browser does not support passkeys, or JavaScript is turned off.
account.passkeys.hint: With a passkey you sign in by fingerprint, face or device PIN, without a password.
account.title: Account
auth.error.locked: Too many failed attempts. Please try again in %d minutes.
auth.error.name_too_long: The name can have at most %d characters.
auth.error.passkey: The passkey didn't work. Please try again.
auth.error.password_too_long: The password can have at most %d characters.
auth.error.password_too_short: The password needs at least %d characters.
auth.error.setup_token: The setup token is wrong. Please open the link from the server log.
auth.error.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute.
auth.field.name: Name
auth.login.title: Sign in
auth.setup.intro: Create your account. Afterwards you can add a passkey to sign in without a password.
auth.setup.title: Set up Spokebook
auth.setup.token_hint: The server writes a link with the token to its log at startup.
backup.error.confirm: Confirm that your data will be replaced.
backup.error.invalid: The file is not a Spokebook backup or is damaged. Nothing was changed.
backup.error.too_large: The file is too large (at most %d MB). Nothing was changed.
backup.error.version: The backup comes from a newer version of Spokebook. Update Spokebook first. Nothing was changed.
backup.import.confirm: Replace all my data with the backup
backup.import.title: Import backup
backup.import.warning: The import replaces all your bikes, odometer readings, components, component types, catalog steps, maintenances, rides and photos and documents with the content of the file. This can't be undone, so export your current data first if you might still need it. Your account, password and passkeys stay unchanged.
bike.components.no_spares: There is no spare component, i.e. one that is active and not installed.
bike.features.hint: Features switch on extra maintenance steps and hints, e.g. carbon assembly paste on clamps or checking the tubeless sealant.
bike.in_service.hint: 0 km for new and self-built bikes, the taken-over odometer for used ones. Components can be installed before the first ride.
bike.values.empty: No measurements yet, e.g. saddle height, stack or reach.
bike.values.hint: Measurements document the bike, e.g. its geometry and your fit. They are only shown, never checked during maintenance. For a single value, fill in “From” only. Clear a row to remove it; save and edit again for more rows. Suspension settings such as fork pressure and sag belong to the fork or shock.
bikes.field.name: Name
bikes.title: Bikes
catalog.accessories.instructions: Fenders, rack, kickstand, bell and reflectors are tight.
catalog.accessories.title: Check accessories
catalog.adjust_brakes.instructions: Center the calipers so nothing rubs and set the lever reach.
catalog.adjust_brakes.title: Adjust the brakes
catalog.adjust_derailleur.instructions: Set the limit screws, cable tension and B-screw.
catalog.adjust_derailleur.title: Adjust the rear derailleur
catalog.adjust_front_derailleur.instruct: Set the limit screws, height and angle.
catalog.adjust_front_derailleur.title: Adjust the front derailleur
catalog.adjust_headset.instructions: Adjust it free of play and running smoothly; then align and tighten the stem.
catalog.adjust_headset.title: Adjust the headset
catalog.axles_tire_pressure.instructions: Tighten thru axles to torque; set the tire pressure as given on the tire.
catalog.axles_tire_pressure.title: Final axles and tire pressure
catalog.belt_clean.instructions: Water and a brush; no degreaser and no oil.
catalog.belt_clean.title: Clean the belt
catalog.belt_sprockets.instructions: Check the tooth shape and wear; clear dirt from the gaps.
catalog.belt_sprockets.title: Inspect the belt sprockets
catalog.belt_tension.instructions: Measure the tension (frequency in Hz with the app) and adjust it to the target value.
catalog.belt_tension.title: Belt tension
catalog.belt_wear.instructions: Look for cracks, missing or worn teeth and frayed edges.
catalog.belt_wear.title: Inspect the belt
catalog.bottom_bracket_play.instructions: Rock the cranks sideways and listen for noises when turning.
catalog.bottom_bracket_play.title: Bottom bracket play
catalog.brake_cables_hoses.instructions: Look for kinks, chafing and leaks.
catalog.brake_cables_hoses.title: Check brake cables and hoses
catalog.brake_function.instructions: Pull the levers and push the bike: the brakes grip and the levers don't reach the handlebar.
catalog.brake_function.title: Check the brakes standing
catalog.brake_pad_thickness.instructions: Measure the pad thickness; limit as specified by the manufacturer.
catalog.brake_pad_thickness.title: Measure brake pad thickness
catalog.brake_test.instructions: Brake several times; bed in new pads.
catalog.brake_test.title: Brake test and bedding in
catalog.carbon_cable_rub.instructions: Check where housings or the chain rub on the frame; check the protective film.
catalog.carbon_cable_rub.title: Cable rub
catalog.carbon_crash_check.instructions: Check the hotspots, do the tap test, check handlebar and stem, saddle and seatpost; if in doubt, have it checked by a professional.
catalog.carbon_crash_check.title: After a crash: thorough check
catalog.carbon_hotspots.instructions: Check head tube, bottom bracket area, dropouts, seat tube slot and down tube (stone chips) for cracks and chips.
catalog.carbon_hotspots.title: Check the hotspots
catalog.carbon_knock_test.instructions: Tap with a coin: a clear sound is fine, a dull one needs a professional check.
catalog.carbon_knock_test.title: Tap test
catalog.carbon_min_insertion.instruction: Observe the marks on seatpost and frame.
catalog.carbon_min_insertion.title: Minimum insertion
catalog.carbon_stand.instructions: Clamp the bike at the seatpost, never at a frame tube.
catalog.carbon_stand.title: Clamp the work stand correctly
catalog.cassette_chainrings.instructions: Look for shark-fin teeth; check that the chain doesn't skip.
catalog.cassette_chainrings.title: Cassette and chainrings
catalog.chain_wear.instructions: Measure with a chain checker; replace from about 0.5 % (11/12-speed) or 0.75 % (up to 10-speed).
catalog.chain_wear.title: Measure chain wear
catalog.clean_braking_surfaces.instructi: Degrease rotors or rim sidewalls with isopropyl alcohol.
catalog.clean_braking_surfaces.title: Clean braking surfaces
catalog.degrease_drivetrain.instructions: Clean with degreaser and a brush, then let it dry.
catalog.degrease_drivetrain.title: Degrease chain and cogs
catalog.derailleur_hanger.instructions: Check with an alignment gauge that the hanger is straight.
catalog.derailleur_hanger.title: Check the derailleur hanger
catalog.derailleur_pulleys.instructions: Check the derailleur for play and the pulleys for wear.
catalog.derailleur_pulleys.title: Derailleur and pulleys
catalog.ebike_assist_test.instructions: Try all levels and the walk assist; the motor cuts out at 25 km/h.
catalog.ebike_assist_test.title: Test the assist levels
catalog.ebike_battery.instructions: Check the housing for cracks and deformation; contacts clean and dry.
catalog.ebike_battery.title: Inspect the battery
catalog.ebike_battery_data.instructions: Note charge cycles and capacity if diagnostics are available.
catalog.ebike_battery_data.title: Record battery data
catalog.ebike_battery_mount.instructions: The battery sits without play; the lock works.
catalog.ebike_battery_mount.title: Battery mount and lock
catalog.ebike_charger.instructions: Check housing, cable and plug for damage.
catalog.ebike_charger.title: Charger and cable
catalog.ebike_diagnostics.instructions: Read the error memory and update motor, battery and display (workshop); keep the report.
catalog.ebike_diagnostics.title: Diagnostics and software update
catalog.ebike_display.instructions: Check the display, buttons and mount.
catalog.ebike_display.title: Display and remote
catalog.ebike_motor_mount.instructions: Check them with a torque wrench as specified by the frame or motor manufacturer.
catalog.ebike_motor_mount.title: Motor mounting bolts
catalog.ebike_speed_sensor.instructions: Check the gap between sensor and magnet and that the holder is tight.
catalog.ebike_speed_sensor.title: Speed sensor
catalog.ebike_wiring.instructions: Look for chafing and corrosion; connectors sit firmly.
catalog.ebike_wiring.title: Cables and connectors
catalog.eshift_battery.instructions: Note the charge level and charge if needed; contacts clean.
catalog.eshift_battery.title: Shifting battery
catalog.eshift_firmware.instructions: Update the firmware with the manufacturer's app.
catalog.eshift_firmware.title: Shifting firmware
catalog.eshift_wiring.instructions: Connectors sit firmly, cables without chafing. Hide this step for wireless shifting.
catalog.eshift_wiring.title: Shifting cables and connectors
catalog.finish.instructions: Check the measurements and replaced parts, set the next date.
catalog.finish.title: Finish the maintenance
catalog.grips_tape.instructions: They are tight and the end plugs are in place.
catalog.grips_tape.title: Check grips or bar tape
catalog.headset_play.instructions: Pull the front brake and rock the bike back and forth: no knocking.
catalog.headset_play.title: Check headset play
catalog.hub_bearings.instructions: Check for play across the axle and rough running.
catalog.hub_bearings.title: Check hub bearings
catalog.hub_gear_adjust.instructions: Set the cable tension so the marks on the shifter housing line up.
catalog.hub_gear_adjust.title: Adjust the hub gear
catalog.hub_gear_check.instructions: No oil leaking; torque arm and axle nuts tight.
catalog.hub_gear_check.title: Check the gear hub
catalog.hub_gear_oil.instructions: Oil change or oil bath as specified by the manufacturer.
catalog.hub_gear_oil.title: Change the hub oil
catalog.hydraulic_bleed.instructions: Bleed and change the fluid the brake asks for (mineral oil or DOT, never mix them); as the manufacturer says or when the bite point feels spongy.
catalog.hydraulic_bleed.title: Bleed the brakes
catalog.hydraulic_leaks.instructions: Check hoses, fittings, calipers and levers for oil, kinks and chafing.
catalog.hydraulic_leaks.title: Hoses and leaks
catalog.hydraulic_pressure_point.instruc: Pull each lever several times: the bite point is firm and doesn't move towards the bar.
catalog.hydraulic_pressure_point.title: Check the bite point
catalog.inspect_frame_fork.instructions: Look for cracks, dents and chipped paint, especially at welds and dropouts.
catalog.inspect_frame_fork.title: Inspect frame and fork
catalog.inspect_handlebar_stem.instructi: Look for cracks and scores at the clamps; the handlebar is square to the bike.
catalog.inspect_handlebar_stem.title: Inspect handlebar and stem
catalog.inspect_tires.instructions: Check tread, cuts, embedded objects and sidewalls.
catalog.inspect_tires.title: Inspect the tires
catalog.lights.instructions: Check front and rear light, cables and aim.
catalog.lights.title: Lights
catalog.lubricate_chain.instructions: Apply oil to the rollers and wipe off the excess.
catalog.lubricate_chain.title: Lubricate the chain
catalog.lubricate_pivots.instructions: Oil the derailleur pivots and brake lever pivots.
catalog.lubricate_pivots.title: Oil pivots and cable entries
catalog.noise_check.instructions: Lift and drop the bike, turn the cranks: note any rattling or creaking.
catalog.noise_check.title: Noise check
catalog.pedals.instructions: Check play, smooth running and cleats or bindings.
catalog.pedals.title: Pedals
catalog.record_odometer.instructions: Note the odometer; write down anything unusual and known problems.
catalog.record_odometer.title: Record odometer and issues
catalog.replace_belt.instructions: Never kink, twist or roll up the belt.
catalog.replace_belt.title: Replace the belt
catalog.replace_brake_pads.instructions: Push back the pistons, fit the new pads with the retaining pin; bed them in on the test ride.
catalog.replace_brake_pads.title: Replace brake pads
catalog.replace_cables.instructions: Fit them with ferrules and cable end caps.
catalog.replace_cables.title: Replace cables and housings
catalog.replace_cassette_chainring.instr: Tighten the lockring and chainring bolts to torque.
catalog.replace_cassette_chainring.title: Replace cassette or chainring
catalog.replace_chain.instructions: Shorten the new chain to length and close it with the quick link; then check the shifting.
catalog.replace_chain.title: Replace the chain
catalog.replace_tires.title: Replace tires
catalog.ride_noises.instructions: Listen for creaking and rattling; check that the bike tracks straight.
catalog.ride_noises.title: Noises and handling
catalog.rim_wear.instructions: Check the wear indicator or groove on the rim.
catalog.rim_wear.title: Rim wear (rim brakes)
catalog.rotor_thickness.instructions: Measure the rotor thickness; the minimum is typically about 1.5 mm, follow the manufacturer.
catalog.rotor_thickness.title: Measure rotor thickness
catalog.saddle_seatpost.instructions: Check rails and clamp; observe the minimum insertion.
catalog.saddle_seatpost.title: Saddle and seatpost
catalog.service_seatpost.instructions: Use carbon assembly paste instead of grease for carbon.
catalog.service_seatpost.title: Remove, clean and grease the seatpost
catalog.shift_cables.instructions: Look for fraying, rust and stiffness.
catalog.shift_cables.title: Shift cables and housings
catalog.shift_test.instructions: Shift through all gears under load; the chain must not skip.
catalog.shift_test.title: Shift through the gears
catalog.suspension_clean.instructions: Wipe stanchions, shock shaft and suspension seatpost with a clean cloth; a drop of suspension oil on the wipers.
catalog.suspension_clean.title: Clean the stanchions
catalog.suspension_play.instructions: Front brake on, rock the bike: no play in the fork bushings, shock mounts or linkage bearings; the saddle doesn't wobble on a suspension seatpost.
catalog.suspension_play.title: Check bushings and bearings
catalog.suspension_sag.instructions: Set the pressure or spring of fork, shock and suspension seatpost in riding kit and measure the sag; adjust rebound.
catalog.suspension_sag.title: Set air pressure and sag
catalog.suspension_seals.instructions: Look for oil rings, dirt under the wipers and scratches on the stanchions.
catalog.suspension_seals.title: Check wipers and seals
catalog.suspension_service.instructions: Lower leg and air can service with new oil and seals after the operating hours specified by the manufacturer.
catalog.suspension_service.title: Service fork and shock
catalog.tire_pressure_axles.instructions: Check the tire pressure; quick releases or thru axles are tight.
catalog.tire_pressure_axles.title: Tire pressure and axles
catalog.torque_accessories.instructions: Tighten bottle cages, rack and fenders.
catalog.torque_accessories.title: Accessory bolts
catalog.torque_brakes.instructions: Check them with a torque wrench; threadlocker as specified by the manufacturer.
catalog.torque_brakes.title: Caliper and rotor bolts
catalog.torque_cockpit.instructions: Check handlebar and steerer clamp, brake and shift levers with a torque wrench.
catalog.torque_cockpit.title: Cockpit bolts to torque
catalog.torque_cranks_pedals.instruction: Check crank bolts, chainring bolts and pedals with a torque wrench.
catalog.torque_cranks_pedals.title: Tighten cranks and pedals
catalog.torque_derailleurs.instructions: Check the mounting and cable clamp bolts of rear and front derailleur with a torque wrench.
catalog.torque_derailleurs.title: Derailleur bolts
catalog.torque_saddle.instructions: Check the seatpost clamp in the frame and the saddle rail clamp with a torque wrench.
catalog.torque_saddle.title: Seatpost and saddle rail clamps
catalog.torque_suspension.instructions: Check shock mounts, linkage, fork crown and suspension seatpost with a torque wrench.
catalog.torque_suspension.title: Fork and shock bolts
catalog.true_wheel.instructions: Only if it runs out laterally or radially.
catalog.true_wheel.title: True the wheel
catalog.tube_valve.instructions: The valve is straight, the cap is on, no pressure loss.
catalog.tube_valve.title: Tube and valve
catalog.tubeless_after_co2.instructions: Check the sealant at home and renew it if needed; CO₂ makes it dry out faster.
catalog.tubeless_after_co2.title: After a CO₂ repair
catalog.tubeless_sealant.instructions: Shake and listen or check with a dipstick through the valve: enough, top up or renew.
catalog.tubeless_sealant.title: Check the sealant
catalog.tubeless_sealant_change.instruct: Remove the tire, clean out old clumps, check the rim tape, refill; about every 12–18 months.
catalog.tubeless_sealant_change.title: Change the sealant completely
catalog.tubeless_sealant_leaks.instructi: Look for residue on sidewall, bead and valve.
catalog.tubeless_sealant_leaks.title: Sealant leaks
catalog.tubeless_top_up.instructions: Top up through the valve with a syringe; amount as specified by the manufacturer.
catalog.tubeless_top_up.title: Top up sealant
catalog.tubeless_valve_core.instructions: Clean or replace a clogged valve core.
catalog.tubeless_valve_core.title: Clean or replace the valve core
catalog.wash_bike.instructions: Wash from top to bottom; don't point a hard water jet at bearings.
catalog.wash_bike.title: Wash the bike
catalog.wheel_true_spokes.instructions: Check lateral and radial runout; compare spoke tension by squeezing pairs.
catalog.wheel_true_spokes.title: Wheel true and spokes
component.duplicate.hint: Creates a new component with the same details. Installations are not copied.
component.install.no_bikes: There is no active bike yet.
component.odometer_hint: Leave empty to use the bike's odometer on that date; it follows rides imported later. A different value is saved as odometer reading.
components.title: Components
confirm.delete_bike: Delete the bike “%s” with all its odometer readings and maintenance records? This can't be undone.
confirm.delete_component: Delete the component “%s” with its installation history? This can't be undone. To keep the history, retire it instead.
confirm.delete_installation: Delete the installation from %s? The component's mileage from it will be lost.
confirm.delete_reading: Delete the odometer reading of %s from %s?
confirm.title: Really delete?
error.bike_has_installations: Components were installed on this bike, so deleting it would lose their mileage. Retire the bike instead.
error.incomplete_removal: An odometer at removal needs a date.
error.install_overlap: The component was still installed elsewhere on this date.
error.invalid_currency: Please enter a three-letter currency code such as EUR.
error.invalid_km: Please enter a distance of 0 km or more.
error.invalid_max_km: Please enter a max. mileage above 0 km.
error.invalid_measured: Please enter a valid number for “%s”.
error.invalid_url: Please enter a full link starting with http:// or https://.
error.invalid_value: Each value needs a label and at least one valid number.
error.km_below_service: The odometer can't be below %s, the odometer when the bike went into service.
error.km_too_high: The odometer can't be above %s (reading from %s).
error.km_too_low: The odometer can't be below %s (reading from %s).
error.limit_bounds: A limit needs either “from” or “to”, not both.
error.maintenance_completed: This maintenance is completed. Reopen it to change it.
error.no_odometer: The bike has no odometer reading on or before this date. Please enter the odometer.
error.no_steps: Please choose a level with steps or at least one on-demand step.
error.no_steps_chosen: Please choose at least one step.
error.reading_before_service: The date can't be before the bike went into service.
error.rides_before_service: There are rides of this bike before this date. Please assign them to another bike or discard them first.
error.readings_before_service: There are odometer readings before this date. Please change or delete them first.
error.readings_below_service: There are odometer readings below this odometer. Please change or delete them first.
error.removal_before_installation: Removal can't be before the installation (date or odometer).
error.retire_no_odometer: Components are installed, but the bike has no odometer reading at that date. Please enter the odometer.
error.retired: This is retired. Reactivate it first.
error.type_in_use: This type is used by components and can't be deleted.
hint.carbon_torque: Carbon: a torque wrench is a must, never by feel; carbon assembly paste only on clamping surfaces, never on threads.
hint.ebike_chain_wear: E-bike: the motor wears the chain faster; check it more often.
hint.ebike_wash: E-bike: remove the battery first; no high-pressure jet at motor and connectors.
hint.eshift_adjust: Electronic shifting: adjust with the buttons or the app, there is no cable tension.
hint.hydraulic_pads: Hydraulic: push the pistons back carefully; never pull the lever without pads or a spacer.
hint.suspension_wash: Suspension: no water jet at the seals; wipe the stanchions clean afterwards.
hint.tubeless_pressure: Tubeless: lower pressure is possible; follow the rim and tire manufacturer.
installation.removal_hint: Leave removal empty while the component is installed. An empty odometer follows the bike's odometer on that date.
maintenance.add_steps.hint: The steps are copied with the values of the components installed at the date of the maintenance.
maintenance.all_steps_added: This maintenance already contains all steps of the catalog.
maintenance.edit_date.hint: A new odometer is recorded as a reading. The copied steps and values stay as they are.
maintenance.no_steps: There are no maintenance steps yet.
maintenance.start.hint: The steps of the level, the chosen on-demand steps and the values of the installed components are copied. Later changes don't change this maintenance.
maintenance.title: Maintenance
maintenances.title: Maintenance
replace.keep_hint: Otherwise it stays available, e.g. as a spare.
replace.use_existing: Use an existing component instead (a spare that is not installed)
retire.bike.hint: Installed components are removed at this date.
retire.component.hint: The component is removed at this date.
step.component_values: Plus the values of the installed components: %s
step.field.component_type.hint: During maintenance the step also shows the values of the components of these types installed on the bike, limited to the chosen kinds (none = all kinds).
step.field.levels.hint: A maintenance at a level contains all steps of that level. Without a level the step is done on demand and can be chosen when starting a maintenance.
step.field.module.hint: A step with a feature only goes into maintenances of bikes with that feature.
step.field.title: Title
steps.empty: No maintenance steps yet. Add the steps you do, sorted by phase and assembly group.
steps.hidden.hint: Deleted built-in steps are only hidden, so they don't come back with updates. Restore puts them back at their old place.
steps.title: Maintenance steps
types.field.name: Name
types.hidden.hint: Deleted types are only hidden, so built-in ones don't come back with updates. Restoring makes them available again, with their default values.
types.hint: Clear the name of a built-in type to restore its default name. Types in use can't be deleted.
types.title: Component types
types.values.hint: Default values apply to every component of this type. A component's value with the same label overrides the default.
value.field.label: Label
value.hint: Kind: a torque and an info are only shown, a limit (only “from” = minimum or only “to” = maximum) and a target range are measured during maintenance. An info (e.g. tire width) never appears in a maintenance. “Automatic” picks torque for Nm, limit for one bound, otherwise target range. Clear a row to remove it; save and edit again for more rows.
value.title: Values
warning.duplicate: “%s” is already installed at this position.
intervals.title: Intervals
intervals.hint: A level is due after so many months or kilometers, whatever comes first. It counts from the last completed maintenance of this or a higher level, else from the bike going into service.
intervals.empty_hint: An empty field means no limit of that kind. With both empty the level is never due.
step.field.interval.hint: Optional. The step becomes due regardless of its levels, counted from when it was last ticked in a completed maintenance, e.g. servicing a suspension seatpost every 500 km.
error.invalid_interval: Invalid interval: whole months from 1 to 120 and kilometers above 0.
due.title: Due
rides.title: Rides
rides.empty: No rides yet. Import FIT, GPX or TCX files to count the kilometers per bike.
rides.bulk.hint: These actions apply to all rides the filter shows. Discarded rides stay discarded when they are imported again; deleted rides come back with a new file import, but not from Garmin Connect.
rides.result.unassigned.one: %d is not assigned to a bike.
rides.result.unassigned.other: %d are not assigned to a bike.
rides.import.title: Import rides
rides.import.intro: Only date and distance are read; the files are not kept. Files imported before are recognized and skipped.
rides.import.files_hint: FIT, GPX or TCX, also gzip compressed; together at most %d MB.
rides.import.bike_hint: For rides whose file doesn't name a bike, or names one without mapping.
rides.preview.title: Check import
rides.preview.gears_hint: The files name these bikes or devices. Remembered mappings are used for later imports.
rides.error.upload: The files could not be uploaded.
rides.error.too_large: The files are too large (at most %d MB together).
rides.error.too_many: Too many rides (at most %d per import).
rides.error.none: No ride found in the files.
rides.error.format: not a FIT, GPX or TCX file
rides.error.before_service: The ride is dated before the bike went into service.
rides.edit.title: Ride
rides.edit.discarded: This ride is discarded and doesn't count.
rides.edit.bike_hint: Chosen by hand, the bike stays when the mapping changes.
rides.gears.intro: A bike in a file (Garmin gear, bike profile, activity profile or device) is mapped to a bike here. The name in the file doesn't need to match.
rides.gears.empty: No mappings yet. They are created when importing files that name a bike or device.
rides.gear.existing: Also move the rides imported so far
rides.gear.existing_hint: Rides assigned by hand keep their bike.
rides.delete_hint: A discarded ride no longer counts and stays discarded when its file is imported again. A deleted ride is gone; importing its file again adds it again.
confirm.delete_ride: Delete the ride of %s (%s)? Importing its file again adds it again.
confirm.bulk_discard.one: Discard %d ride (%s)? It no longer counts for any bike.
confirm.bulk_discard.other: Discard %d rides (%s)? They no longer count for any bike.
confirm.bulk_delete_hint: Importing their files again adds them again; Garmin Connect doesn't fetch them again.
rides.import.sports: Other sports such as runs and hikes are skipped. Indoor rides (trainer, Zwift) and activities whose sport is unclear are shown but not ticked.
confirm.delete_gear: Delete the mapping of "%s"? Its rides keep their bike; the next import asks for the bike again.
garmin.title: Garmin Connect
garmin.intro: Fetches your cycling activities from Garmin Connect once a day and counts their kilometers like imported FIT files: the Garmin gear chosen for a ride decides the bike. Rides uploaded as files before are recognized.
garmin.disabled: To connect Garmin Connect, the server must be started with APP_SECRET_KEY (at least 32 characters); it encrypts the API key.
garmin.more: More rides are left; the next fetch follows in about an hour.
garmin.until: Fetched up to the ride of %s.
garmin.schedule: New rides are fetched once a day. A fetch takes at most 100 rides; if more are left, the next fetch follows after an hour until all are there.
garmin.too_soon: The last fetch was only a few minutes ago. Please try again later.
garmin.run_error.unauthorized: Garmin refused the API key; it has probably expired. Enter a new one under Settings.
garmin.run_error.rate_limited: Garmin reported too many requests. The next fetch tries again.
garmin.run_error.secret: The stored API key can't be decrypted (was APP_SECRET_KEY changed?). Enter it again under Settings.
garmin.run_error.failed: Fetching failed; the server log has the details. The next fetch tries again.

garmin.since_earlier: An earlier day fetches the time before.
